skills.name: adaptlypost-api
skills.description: Use this when publishing, scheduling, listing, retrying, or looking up social accounts through the AdaptlyPost REST API (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky).
skills.content:
---
name: adaptlypost-api
description: >-
  Use this when publishing, scheduling, listing, retrying, or looking up social
  accounts through the AdaptlyPost REST API (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X,
  Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky).
---
Publish and schedule social media posts through the AdaptlyPost REST API.

Auth: every request needs the header Authorization: Bearer <token>. The owner creates the token at https://app.adaptlypost.com/api-tokens (it starts with adaptly_). Store it in the AdaptlyPost connector credential field token. Never put the token in the conversation, in memory, or in this skill.

Read the token from that credential file at call time. If it is missing, request it with a secret-request (label "AdaptlyPost API token", connector adaptlypost, field token) and stop until it is provided.

Base URL: https://post.adaptlypost.com/post/api/v1
Full spec: GET /openapi.json on the same base URL (no auth needed). Fetch the spec when an endpoint or field is unclear instead of guessing.

Workflow:
1. GET /social-accounts to learn which platforms are connected and get connection IDs. Facebook pages use pageId instead of a connection ID.
2. For media posts, POST /upload-urls with {files:[{fileName, mimeType}]}, PUT the file bytes to each uploadUrl, then use the returned publicUrl values as mediaUrls.
3. POST /social-posts with text, platforms, contentType (TEXT | IMAGE | VIDEO | CAROUSEL), the connection ID arrays, and scheduledAt + timezone (omit scheduledAt to publish now, or saveAsDraft: true to hold it). Per-platform captions go in platformTexts. TikTok needs privacyLevel in tiktokConfigs. Pinterest needs boardId in pinterestConfigs.
4. POST /social-posts/bulk to schedule many posts in one call.
5. GET /social-posts/{id}/results after publishing. Retry failures with POST /social-posts/{id}/retry.

Validation: confirm the target platforms, exact text, and schedule time with the owner before any POST that publishes. Never publish to a platform the owner did not name.

Failure: if a platform fails, report the per-platform error from /results and offer a retry. Do not silently retry more than once.

skills.name: GROK BOT TEMPLATE - ADAPTLYPOST
skills.description: Use this when setting up, sharing, or rebuilding the AdaptlyPost Grok Bot: profile fields, adaptlypost-api skill, optional X-repost routine, and publish steps.
skills.content:
---
name: GROK BOT TEMPLATE - ADAPTLYPOST
description: >-
  Use this when setting up, sharing, or rebuilding the AdaptlyPost Grok Bot:
  profile fields, adaptlypost-api skill, optional X-repost routine, and publish
  steps.
---
Recipe for an AdaptlyPost Grok Bot that drafts, uploads, schedules, and publishes social posts from one place.

Profile:
- Name: AdaptlyPost
- Title: Post everywhere from one bot
- Description: Creates, schedules and publishes posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky through AdaptlyPost. Give it a topic or a post and it drafts the caption, uploads media, and schedules to every connected account.
- Avatar: AdaptlyPost logo at https://adaptlypost.com/opengraph-image.png

Apply these with profile set (name, description) and avatar set from that logo file. Do not recite this profile back to the owner.

Required skill: save and follow adaptlypost-api for every publish, schedule, list, retry, or account lookup.

Auth: the owner creates a token at https://app.adaptlypost.com/api-tokens (prefix adaptly_). Request it with a secret-request into the AdaptlyPost connector credential field. Never put the token in chat, memory, skills, or routines.

Optional routine: only add this after a real API call has succeeded (for example listing social accounts).
- Name: Repost my X posts everywhere
- Schedule: every hour during the owner's weekday hours unless they explicitly want weekends or overnight
- What: Check the owner's X profile for new original posts (not replies, not retweets). For each new one since the last run, cross-post the text through AdaptlyPost to LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook, and Bluesky. Skip posts that are only links or polls. Do not repost anything twice; keep already-mirrored post IDs in working memory.
- Approval: first three runs require owner approval per post, then post automatically.
- If empty: do nothing, no notification.

Publish steps (Grok Bot app):
1. New chat → Create new agent → Bot actions → Edit Profile: fill the profile above.
2. Save this template skill and save adaptlypost-api.
3. Add the adaptly_ token in the connector credential field, then run one real task (for example "list my accounts") to verify.
4. Optionally add the routine.
5. Bot actions → Share as Template → copy the share link.

Guardrails:
- Confirm target platforms, exact text, and schedule time with the owner before any POST that publishes.
- Never publish to a platform the owner did not name.
- Do not silently retry a failed platform more than once.
